title: How Decisions Get Made
grammar: hiába; recap of ugyanakkor and mindazonáltal
goal: I can say that an effort was in vain with hiába.
I can add a second point with ugyanakkor and mindazonáltal.
I can talk about elections with four new words, such as szavazati jog and politikai párt.
I can say what a koalíció is.
